title: One Earth Chant
style: Reggae with a laid-back one-drop groove and skanking guitar on the offbeat; verse rides sparse drums, warm bass, and hand percussion, pre-chorus lifts with rising organ chords and harmony stacks, chorus opens with call-and-response vocals and a chantable hook. Lead vocal stays close-mic and soulful with doubled chorus lines, ad-lib echoes, and light crowd-style shouts. Bamboo chimes, reversed rim swells, and a subtle dub delay toss into transitions. Bright, earthy, and sun-warmed mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Walk with love, my brother
Walk with love, my sister
Share a little bread
Share the shade
One small kindness
Can change the day

The river keeps its promise
The mango tree still gives
If we care for what we’re given
That is how we live
No need for hate in the yard
No need for fear in the door
Raise up your hand in blessing
And give a little more

[Pre-Chorus]
Hear the drum call slow
Feel the ground below
Every heart can grow
If we let it show

[Chorus]
One Earth, one heart
One love, one start
Pacha mama, hold us near
Rastafari, we sing it clear
One Earth, one heart
Keep the living part
Love your neighbor, plant that seed
Give the world what it needs

[Verse 2]
From Kingston to the mountains
From the sand to the rain
The same blue sky is watching
Over joy and pain
Don’t take more than your sharing
Don’t break what you can mend
The ground remembers footsteps
So let your good love send

Salt on the skin at sunrise
Leaves turning in the breeze
Children laugh in the doorway
Peace in the trees
When the old road turns to dust
And the dry wind starts to cry
We water down the anger
And let the good roots rise

[Pre-Chorus]
Hear the drum call slow
Feel the ground below
Every heart can grow
If we let it show

[Chorus]
One Earth, one heart
One love, one start
Pacha mama, hold us near
Rastafari, we sing it clear
One Earth, one heart
Keep the living part
Love your neighbor, plant that seed
Give the world what it needs

[Bridge]
No divide can last
When the people stand as one
Gently on this land
Under one bright sun
Bless the soil, bless the rain
Bless the hands that work and care
If we keep this promise
Love will meet us there

[Final Chorus]
One Earth, one heart
One love, one start
Pacha mama, hold us near
Rastafari, we sing it clear
One Earth, one heart
Keep the living part
Love your neighbor, plant that seed
Give the world what it needs

One Earth, one heart
One love, one start
Pacha mama, hold us near
Rastafari, we sing it clear
